angels.name: Angels
angels.description: Guardian angels and the heavenly court appear as protectors of the voyage and the mission enterprise.

blood-of-christ.name: Blood of Christ
blood-of-christ.description: The blood of Christ, shed for all souls, is the writers' great argument: souls redeemed at so high a price must not perish for lack of laborers.

china-mission-to.name: China, mission to
china-mission-to.description: The China mission — the most frequently named specific destination. Writers ask to be sent with the Father Procurator of China or to join the Chinese enterprise.

cross-and-suffering.name: Cross and suffering
cross-and-suffering.description: The desire to suffer — toil, hardship, and death for Christ — is central to nearly every petition; the cross is both the means and the proof of love.

gonzaga-st-aloysius.name: Gonzaga, St. Aloysius
gonzaga-st-aloysius.description: St. Aloysius Gonzaga, the youthful Jesuit saint, is invoked as a model of purity and early holiness.

health.name: Health
health.description: Writers discuss their bodily health — offering it, lamenting its weakness, or reporting recovery — as it bears on fitness for the voyage.

heaven-hell-and-purgatory.name: Heaven, hell, and purgatory
heaven-hell-and-purgatory.description: The eternal fates — heaven hoped for, hell feared for the unevangelized, purgatory accepted — frame the urgency of the petitions.

humility.name: Humility
humility.description: The most widely indexed topic: writers insist on their unworthiness, lowliness, and sins even as they press their suit.

ignatius-of-loyola-st.name: Ignatius of Loyola, St.
ignatius-of-loyola-st.description: St. Ignatius of Loyola, founder of the Society, is cited as father, model of governance, and heavenly patron.

japan-mission-to.name: Japan, mission to
japan-mission-to.description: The Japan mission — second only to China among named destinations — draws many petitions, especially after the news of recent martyrs.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.description: The hope of martyrdom — shedding one's blood for the faith in the missions — is named explicitly as a motive.

novitiate.name: Novitiate
novitiate.description: Writers recall their novitiate fervor or write as novices and young scholastics discerning the call.

obedience.name: Obedience
obedience.description: Obedience to the General's judgment: every petition is submitted to Vitelleschi's decision, and writers profess indifference to the outcome.

other-missions.name: Other missions
other-missions.description: Petitions naming destinations beyond the great four (China, Japan, Paraguay, Philippines) — Ethiopia, England, the Mughal empire, and others.

paraguay-mission-to.name: Paraguay, mission to
paraguay-mission-to.description: The Paraguay mission (the reductions), named by a few writers as their desired field.

philippines-mission-to.name: Philippines, mission to
philippines-mission-to.description: The Philippines mission. One letter (146) is indexed here though the writer declares he has no vocation for it — see the source note.

spiritual-exercises.name: Spiritual Exercises
spiritual-exercises.description: The Spiritual Exercises of St. Ignatius — retreats, discernment, and the examen — as the ground of the writers' petitions.

studies.name: Studies
studies.description: Writers report on their studies (grammar, rhetoric, philosophy, theology) and ask that studies not delay their departure.

tears.name: Tears
tears.description: Tears — wept in prayer, in writing, and in longing — are a recurring language of these petitions.

virgin-mary.name: Virgin Mary
virgin-mary.description: The Virgin Mary is invoked as mother, patroness, and mediatrix of the desired grace.

vows.name: Vows
vows.description: Vows already made — of religion, of the Indies, of martyrdom — and the desire to bind oneself further by vow.

xavier-st-francis.name: Xavier, St. Francis
xavier-st-francis.description: St. Francis Xavier, Apostle of the Indies, is the great exemplar and heavenly patron invoked across the collection.

zeal-for-souls.name: Zeal for souls
zeal-for-souls.description: Zeal for the salvation of souls — the motive stated most often and most ardently for seeking the missions.
